title: Ingredient
description: Food ingredient with nutritional information, category, measurement unit, and allergen data. Used for recipe management, meal planning, and dietary tracking applications.

name.description: Name of the ingredient (e.g., flour, tomatoes, olive oil)

category.description: Ingredient category (e.g., vegetables, grains, dairy, spices, proteins)

unit.description: Standard measurement unit (e.g., grams, cups, tablespoons, pieces)

calories.description: Calories per standard unit of the ingredient

allergens.description: List of allergens present (e.g., gluten, dairy, nuts, eggs, soy)
